newsitem.title: USA: CryoLife Inc signs UK output agreement.
newsitem.headline: CryoLife Inc signs UK output agreement.

text.p: CryoLife Inc said Tuesday it had signed an agreement with Tissuemed Ltd of Leeds, England to continue producing its two advanced design stentless porcine heart valves for more two years.
"The new operating agreement provides CryoLife with a firm and longer-term manufacturing base for addressing Europe's $75 million annual tissue heart valve market," it said.
Tissuemed makes the CryoLife-O'Brien stentless porcine heart valves for distribution by CryoLife in the European Community.
Porcine is tissue or cells derived from pigs. Stentless heart valves do not have any artificial material to immobilize tissue, such as sewing rings.

CryoLife, which specializes in technology for ultra-low temperature preservation of viable human cardiovascular and orthopaedic tissues for use in surgery, said Tissumed had been making the valves under an old agreement signed in 1995.
